880-2907-8345.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-2907-8345.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the land enters the battlefield, Scute Swarm triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

751-3755-7297.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2301-4210-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2301-4210-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Wayward Disciple, Abzan Ascendancy and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Wayward Disciple trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy ability, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Wayward Disciple triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

3560-3899-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat from step 3.

872-3147-7857.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Scaled Herbalist.
Repeat.

1417-2946-3967-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
1417-2946-3967-4871.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1453-2921--5.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Arwen
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2155-3259-7297.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature with the greatest power among creatures on the battlefield.
2155-3259-7297.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2155-3259-7297.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Éomer of the Riddermark as attackers.
Éomer of the Riddermark triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3532-5078-6259-6608.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Jace's Projection triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3259-5722-6633.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls no creatures.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature other than Wasitora.
3259-5722-6633.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent who controls no creatures using Wasitora and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Wasitora.
Resolve the Wasitora trigger, creating a 3/3 Cat Dragon creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Cat Dragon, then causing you to untap all creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat damage.

1636-3634-6406.notablePrerequisites: You control enough creatures such that you can cast Venser between mana produced by those creatures and its convoke ability.
1636-3634-6406.description:
Cast Venser by tapping a number of creatures and paying {0}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Venser trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
1636-3634-6406.notes: You can tap creatures for mana instead if that's more advantageous, and use that mana when casting the creature.

729-4702.easyPrerequisites: Splinter Twin attached to Great Oak Guardian.
729-4702.description:
Activate Great Oak Guardian by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
When the token Great Oak Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

647-1563-2457-4094.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
647-1563-2457-4094.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

372-3455-4681.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Vizier of Many Faces.
372-3455-4681.description:
Cast Vizier of Many Faces by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Put the original Abdel Adrian into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Vizier of Many Faces's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Vizier of Many Faces ability, choosing to exile Karmic Guide until Vizier of Many Faces leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Vizier of Many Faces into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Abdel Adrian's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian ability, exiling Karmic Guide until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Vizier of Many Faces from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.

1308-1977-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Tivit.
When Tivit enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.
1308-1977-4499.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead vote to get Clue tokens.

222-527-2511-3480.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-2511-3480.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2459-3156-4336-4763.notablePrerequisites: Demonmail Hauberk attached to Kobolds of Kher Keep.
2459-3156-4336-4763.description:
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep, targeting Rograkh.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Koll triggers, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Rograkh.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Rograkh, targeting Kobolds of Kher Keep.
When Rograkh dies, Koll triggers, returning Rograkh from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Kobolds of Kher Keep.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Repeat.

152-1283-1434-3129.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating two token copies of Chromatic Orrery.
Activate the Chromatic Orrery tokens' first abilities by tapping them, adding {10}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead tap the Chromatic Orrery tokens to draw infinite cards, or target any artifact(s) using Cogwork Assembler's ability.

1712-2060-5003-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Jugan.
Jugan dies, triggering itself and Nim Deathmantle.
Resolve the Jugan trigger, putting five +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Jugan from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Jugan's power.
Repeat.

368-955-1122-2567-4197.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven lands.
368-955-1122-2567-4197.description:
Cast Maelstrom Wanderer by paying {5}{G}{U}{R}, plus commander tax if applicable.
This triggers both of Maelstrom Wanderer's cascade abilities and both of Momir Vig's abilities.
Resolve Momir Vig's first ability, search your library for Avenger of Zendikar and putting it on top of your library.
Resolve one of Maelstrom Wanderer's cascade abilities, exiling Avenger of Zendikar from your library and casting it without paying its mana cost.
Momir Vig's first ability triggers again, causing you to search your library for Thicket Elemental and put it on top of your library.
Avenger of Zendikar enters the battlefield, triggering itself, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token for each land you control.
Resolve the remaining cascade trigger, exiling Thicket Elemental from your library and casting it without paying its mana cost, choosing to pay an additional {1}{G} for its kicker cost.
Momir Vig's first ability triggers again, causing you to search your library for Craterhoof Behemoth and put it on top of your library.
Thicket Elemental enters the battlefield, triggering itself, revealing Craterhoof Behemoth and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Craterhoof Behemoth enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, giving creatures you control trample and +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of creatures you control.
Resolve Momir Vig's final trigger from step 2, revealing the top card of your library and putting it into your hand if it is a creature card.
Maelstrom Wanderer enters the battlefield.
You may attack with all of your creatures since they are granted haste by Maelstrom Wanderer.
